## Description

Briefly describe the change and the rationale. Reference any relevant issue or book page.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Typo / text fix in an existing record
- [ ] New record (feat, spell, item, action, etc.)
- [ ] Mechanics update (rules, choices, prerequisites)
- [ ] Schema or tooling documentation update

## Checklist

- [ ] Changed YAML file(s) are valid UTF-8.
- [ ] Schema validation passed (`npm run check-schemas` or `node scripts/check-schemas.mjs`).
- [ ] No raw Foundry JSON or unsupported markup included.
- [ ] All `@` and `omen://` references resolve to valid records or declared external references.
- [ ] The content complies with the Open RPG Creative (ORC) License (no OGL or proprietary content).
